english: at the end of the street
also: at the end of the road
at the far end of the street
at the top of the street
at the bottom of the street

terms.gloss: at the end of the street, at the far end of the road
terms.grammar: extrēmus agrees with its noun: in extrēmā viā, in extrēmō vīcō; of motion, ad extrēmam viam
evidence: Caes. BG 6.29: in extrēmō ponte turrim tabulātōrum quattuor cōnstituit
terms.comment: Latin says “the street at its end”, with extrēmus agreeing with the noun, as Caesar says in extrēmō ponte, at the end of the bridge; the phrase with viā is ours, made on that model. Not in fīne viae.

terms.gloss: at the top end of the street
evidence: Liv. 2.13: in summā Sacrā viā fuit posita virgō īnsidēns equō
Cic. Planc. 17: quī est in summā Sacrā viā
terms.comment: Of the upper end of a street that climbs, as the Sacred Way does; for the bottom, īnfimus: domus in īnfimō clīvō aedificāta (Liv. 2.7).

phrases.latin: in extrēmō ponte turrim tabulātōrum quattuor cōnstituit
phrases.english: at the end of the bridge he set up a tower four storeys high

phrases.latin: in summā Sacrā viā fuit posita virgō īnsidēns equō
phrases.english: a statue of the girl on horseback was set up at the top of the Sacred Way

phrases.latin: Pistrīna in extrēmō vīcō est, ad sinistram.
phrases.english: The bakery is at the end of the street, on the left.
